name: Scheme.Cover.isSheafFor_sigma_iff
statement: MorphismProperty Scheme.{u}} {F : Scheme.{u}ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type*} [IsZariskiLocalAtSource P] (hF : Presieve.IsSheaf Scheme.zariskiTopology F) {S : Scheme.{u}} (𝒰 : S.Cover (precoverage P)) [Finite 𝒰.I₀] : Presieve.IsSheafFor F (.ofArrows 𝒰.sigma.X 𝒰.sigma.f) ↔ Presieve.IsSheafFor F (.ofArrows 𝒰.X 𝒰.f)
